question: The word "acumen" means:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (1)** i.e. Sharpness in understanding.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"acumen"** means the ability to make good judgments and quick decisions, typically in a particular domain; sharpness of mind and keen insight. (तीव्र बुद्धि और कुशाग्रता)

 
 
• **Example: **Her business acumen helped the company thrive in a competitive market.
 
 
 
• The closest meaning for **'acumen'** is **'sharpness in understanding'**, which indicates having keen insight or perceptiveness. (समझने में तीव्रता)
 
 
• **Example: **He is known for his political acumen and strategic thinking.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sharpness in understanding**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Physical strength** (शारीरिक शक्ति):

 
 
• **Example: **His physical strength allowed him to lift heavy weights easily.
 
 
 
• **Luck** (भाग्य):
 
 
• **Example: **She attributed her success to luck rather than hard work.
 
 
 
• **Longevity** (दीर्घायु):
 
 
• **Example: **The longevity of the ancient tree was remarkable.
 
 

4a:Tef0,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**&am
